verdict.rationale: LangSmith can be driven without its UI. Tracing is enabled through environment variables or SDKs, a full OpenAPI-specified REST API lets you "programmatically create and manage LangSmith resources", and evaluations can run on datasets to catch regressions. Together these support headless automation, but the evidence never documents a CI integration (e.g., running evals as a CI gate) or a dedicated CLI. missing for 10: documented CI/CD integration or regression-gating workflow, an official CLI for headless runs, independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Add tracing to your app in minutes with environment variables, framework integrations, or the SDK.
The LangSmith API is used to programmatically create and manage LangSmith resources
Run evaluations on curated datasets during development to compare versions, benchmark performance, and catch regressions.
Filter, export, share, and compare traces via the UI or API.
